title: (Re)Discover KTEQ
body:
After 55 years of broadcasting from the Black Hills, KTEQ is launching something new.

## What's Happening

We're in the middle of a top-to-bottom refresh: new studio equipment, new programming tools, a new website (you're looking at it), and a renewed commitment to the independent radio philosophy that's defined this station since 1971. 

## Why Now

KTEQ has always been scrappy. We've gone silent and come back more than once. We've moved frequencies, rebuilt studios, and weathered every challenge a student-run station can face. In 2025, we were inducted into the South Dakota Rock & Rollers Hall of Fame - a timely reminder that this little station has been a vital culture touchstone for Rapid City for two generations.

Now it's time to build something that will last for the next 55 years.

## What's Coming

- **Studio renovation** through summer 2026
- **New 24/7 programming** with 
- **Grand reopening** and a return to live broadcasts during M-Week, September 25, 2026
- **New fundraising opportunities** to support equipment maintenance, broadcast upgrades, and student workers 

Stay tuned. We're just getting started.
